author: Pablo Casals
quote: I am a Catalan. Today a province of Spain. But what has been Catalonia? Catalonia has been the greatest nation in the world.
sources: Speech to the United Nations General Assembly on receiving the U.N. Peace Medal (24 October 1971)
evidence: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Am_a_Catalan - article gives this wording from Casals' English acceptance speech before the UN General Assembly, 24 October 1971
